name: Fecal Occult Blood
overview: Fecal Occult Blood is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include fecal occult blood (fob) refers to blood in the feces that is not visibly apparent; a fecal occult blood test (fobt) checks for hidden (occult) blood in the stool (feces). This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
purpose: In routine practice, fecal occult blood (FOB) refers to blood in the feces that is not visibly apparent.
From a clinical perspective, a fecal occult blood test (FOBT) checks for hidden (occult) blood in the stool (feces).
